label: Искать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for искать (to look for, search).

missions.phrase: Я ищу свои ключи уже час.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Искать is imperfective with the consonant mutation ск becomes щ in the present, giving 'ищу' on stem ищ-. The perfective partner is найти.

missions.phrase: Кого ты ищешь в этой толпе?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Ищешь' shows the -ешь ending on the mutated stem ищ-. The imperfective stresses the ongoing process of searching, not a result.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Ищет' is the он-form ending in -ет on ищ-. The imperfective with 'давно' frames a long, continuing search.

missions.phrase: Мы ищем выход из этой ситуации.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Ищем' carries the -ем ending on ищ-. The imperfective names an ongoing effort to find a way out, here used figuratively.

missions.phrase: Что вы ищете на этой полке?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person plural or polite present. 'Ищете' trains the respectful вы-form with the -ете ending on ищ-. The imperfective describes a search in progress.

missions.phrase: Они ищут пропавшую собаку по всему району.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Ищут' closes the present ladder with the -ут ending on ищ-. The imperfective stresses the ongoing, area-wide search.

Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Искал' is the masculine singular past of imperfective искать, built on the infinitive stem with -л, without the present-tense mutation. It stresses an extended past search.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Искала' adds the feminine -а ending. The imperfective past with 'везде' underlines a prolonged, repeated act of looking.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Искали' is the plural past ending in -и, completing the past forms. 'Всю ночь' emphasizes the continuous, ongoing nature of the imperfective search.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Ищи' is the informal command form on the mutated stem ищ-, ordering an ongoing search. It pairs naturally with the perfective future 'найдёшь' from найти.
